evals.prompt: I need a plan for migrating our company's internal wiki from Confluence to Notion. We have about 200 pages, 15 team members, and want to do it within 2 months. Can you help me plan this out?
evals.expected_output: Agent should ask clarifying questions about the migration (e.g., content types, permissions, integrations, who owns the migration) before presenting any plan outline
expectations: The first response contains questions directed at the user, not a complete plan
The response does not include a full phase-by-phase plan in the first message
Questions address scope, constraints, or risks specific to the wiki migration
The agent restates understanding of the user's request before asking questions

evals.prompt: help me plan my wedding. we're thinking late september, maybe 80-100 guests, budget around 30k. neither of us have planned one before lol
evals.expected_output: Agent should ask open questions about preferences, priorities, venue style, etc. before outlining any wedding plan
expectations: The first response contains questions, not a wedding plan
Questions are practical and relevant (venue preferences, priorities, cultural/religious considerations, etc.)
The tone matches the casual tone of the user's message
The agent does not immediately produce a timeline or checklist

evals.prompt: We need to implement a new onboarding process for our engineering team. Right now it's kind of ad hoc — new hires just get a laptop and a Slack invite and figure things out. We want something more structured that gets people productive within their first 2 weeks.
evals.expected_output: Agent asks about team size, current pain points, tools/systems new hires need access to, and what 'productive' means before writing a plan
expectations: The first response asks clarifying questions rather than presenting an onboarding plan
Questions probe what 'productive in 2 weeks' means concretely
The agent identifies gaps in the request (team size, role types, existing documentation)
No full plan or phase breakdown appears in the first response
